submit_reasoning: The price history spans roughly Dec 2019 to May 2020 (per anomaly timestamps), while the article was published 2021-11-10 — well outside the series window. All three context events extracted from the article (Zacks Rank upgrade, earnings estimate revisions, FY2022 EPS guidance) were rejected by Aion's ablation gate because their dates fall outside the price history window. The forecast therefore falls back to history alone. The selected model is Theta, which captures the recent recovery trajectory from the ~13.39 trough back toward the 16 range. The series shows a clear V-shaped pattern: decline from ~17.5 to ~13.4, then recovery to ~16.1. The Theta model projects a gentle continued upward drift from 16.11, reaching approximately 15.79 over 33 steps — reflecting the recent recovery momentum while accounting for the overall downtrend from the series start. Support is degraded due to limited evaluation folds, but the model is non-abstaining and represents the best available forecast.
